title: Mae Hong Son vs Pai: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Mae Hong Son for authenticity and culture, Pai for access and backpacker scene. Do both on the Mae Hong Son Loop if you have 5 days from Chiang Mai.

categories.name: Atmosphere & Vibe
categories.summary: Mae Hong Son is genuinely off-the-beaten-path with far fewer tourists. Pai is a well-developed tourist bubble.

categories.name: Temples & Culture
categories.summary: The lakeside Wat Chong Kham/Klang complex is extraordinary. Pai's temples are secondary to outdoor activities.

categories.name: Nature & Outdoors
categories.summary: Pai wins on accessible scenery (canyon, bamboo bridge). Mae Hong Son wins on dramatic, less-crowded landscapes.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Mae Hong Son is 15-25% cheaper on accommodation. Food is similar at local spots.

categories.name: Getting There
categories.summary: Pai is 3.5 hrs from Chiang Mai. Mae Hong Son is 6-8 hrs by road or requires a Bangkok Airways flight.

categories.name: Food
categories.summary: Mae Hong Son has authentic Shan cuisine. Pai has a better café scene and more variety.

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: Pai's Walking Street and bar scene vs Mae Hong Son's quiet evenings.

categories.name: Backpacker Infrastructure
categories.summary: Pai has better-developed hostels, tour agencies, and social infrastructure.

categories.name: Authenticity
categories.summary: Locals outnumber tourists in Mae Hong Son. Pai's tourist bubble is real.

faq.question: Is Mae Hong Son or Pai better for first-time visitors to northern Thailand?
faq.answer: Pai for ease and access. Mae Hong Son for authenticity and culture.

faq.question: How far is Mae Hong Son from Pai?
faq.answer: About 111 km, 2.5-3 hours by mountain road.

faq.question: What is the Mae Hong Son Loop?
faq.answer: A ~600km motorcycle/car circuit from Chiang Mai through Pai, Mae Hong Son, and back via Mae Sariang. One of Thailand's great road trips.
